title: ReBRAC-v2: The Return of the King
abstract: arXiv:2608.01205v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent offline reinforcement learning methods increasingly rely on expressive generative policies and specialized value guidance. We ask how far systematic modernization of a conventional behavior-regularized actor-critic can go while preserving algorithmic simplicity. ReBRAC-v2 directly trains an exact-likelihood normalizing-flow actor with likelihood, MSE, and MAE behavior regularization, classification-based residual critics, staged optimization, and multi-sample inference. We develop one shared configuration through roughly 600 Bayesian proposals on six OGBench tasks, then adapt only two behavior-regularization coefficients using a 16-point grid for the main comparisons. Across ten common OGBench categories, ReBRAC-v2 averages 74.8 versus 52.3 for the next-best method and ranks first in eight categories. Without structural changes, it also obtains the strongest compared averages on D4RL AntMaze (90.2) and Adroit (33.6). Motivated

translated_abstract: 最近的离线强化学习方法日益依赖表达力强的生成式策略和专门的值函数引导。我们探讨在保持算法简洁性的前提下，对传统行为正则化演员-评论家方法进行系统性现代化改造能走多远。ReBRAC-v2 直接训练一个精确似然的归一化流演员，采用似然、MSE 和 MAE 行为正则化、基于分类的残差评论家、分阶段优化以及多样本推理。我们在六个 OGBench 任务上通过约 600 次贝叶斯搜索开发出一个共享配置，然后在主要比较中仅使用 16 点网格调整两个行为正则化系数。在十个常见 OGBench 类别上，ReBRAC-v2 平均得分为 74.8，而次优方法仅为 52.3，并在八个类别中排名第一。在不做任何结构性改动的情况下，它还在 D4RL AntMaze（90.2）和 Adroit（33.6）上取得了所有对比方法中最强的平均成绩。
tldr: ReBRAC-v2 在保持算法简洁的前提下，对传统行为正则化演员-评论家进行系统性现代化改造（归一化流演员、多种行为正则化与残差评论家），在 OGBench 十个类别上平均分 74.8 大幅领先次优方法的 52.3，并在 D4RL AntMaze 和 Adroit 上同样取得最强成绩。
